description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three language models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents performance scores ranging from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.50 and 1.00. Each category contains three grouped bars: dark purple for RedWhale, teal for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and gray for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). In every category, the gray bar (SOLAR) reaches the maximum score of 1.00. RedWhale scores 0.42 in PT-EVAL, 0.52 in KoBEST-BQ, 0.71 in KoBEST-CP, 0.50 in KoBEST-HS, 0.69 in KoBEST-SN, and 0.57 in AVG. EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.46 in PT-EVAL, 0.56 in KoBEST-BQ, 0.74 in KoBEST-CP, 0.54 in KoBEST-HS, 0.73 in KoBEST-SN, and 0.61 in AVG. The chart visually emphasizes that while RedWhale and EEVE-Korean show varying levels of performance across tasks, the SOLAR model consistently achieves perfect scores, suggesting it may serve as a normalized or baseline reference. The bars are not sorted by height, and no additional annotations or emphasis are applied beyond the numerical labels above each bar.
